ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: Image convertor: converts images from any format that can be read to any format that can be written
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Converts files and folders of images between the formats of the loaded image codecs (FreeImage, DevIL, FLIC and the native gupimg format, plus any image codec plugin given with --plugin). Frames, mipmap levels and the pixel format are negotiated with the target format by CImageConverter of gucefIMAGE: what the target cannot hold is converted and what that loses is reported. Animations go to one file where the target holds frames, else to a file per frame. Conversions run on the threads of a pool.
